name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Alvise Pérez
part_text:
The European Parliament has decided to lift the legal protection that Alvise Pérez, a Spanish member of the European Parliament, normally has. Spain's Supreme Court asked for this so it can pursue criminal proceedings against him. The case concerns money he allegedly received in 2024 to fund his party's election campaign, before he became a member. The protection in question covers acts done as a member, and Parliament found no sign that the case is meant to harm his political work.

- **What changes:** Pérez loses his immunity from prosecution in this case.
- **Who it affects:** Alvise Pérez, a member elected in Spain, and the Spanish court.
- **What happens next:** Parliament's President sends the decision to the Spanish authorities and to Pérez, so the case can go ahead.
